svg.aria-label: The port scheduler: three SMS gateways, each with groups of sixteen ports, one port open per group, and a queue of waiting requests beside each group.
svg.text: the port scheduler: gateways, groups, one open port, the queue
A group can hold one port open at a time. The service checks the store first (a code from the last fifteen minutes is returned without opening anything),
else opens the line’s port, polls every ten seconds for up to ninety, and releases the port on every exit, timeout included.
Brass: the open port, and the head of each queue. Hundreds of ports in all; the count, the gateway IDs, and the line numbers stay out of the drawing.
The map, the queues, and the line being served are in process memory.
